title: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
summary: We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time. This is a major milestone for NVIDIA and the AI industry. We have moved from an era in which companies […]
title_es: NVIDIA moviliza $500B para infraestructura de IA con grandes inversores
bajada: NVIDIA anunció alianzas con Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone y otros para crear plataformas de financiamiento independientes. El objetivo es movilizar más de $500 billones en capital de terceros para construcción de infraestructura de IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone and others to create independent financing platforms. The goal is to mobilize over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure buildout.

title: Grok is now an AI ‘teammate’ you can assign work
summary: SpaceXAI has introduced Grok Bot, an always-on AI agent service designed to behave like independent "AI teammates" that can do your work for you. The bots share their own cloud-based computer environment, and can sign into apps, tools, and websites you already use to complete multi-step workplace tasks, only coming back when their assigned work […]
title_es: Grok Bot: agentes IA autónomos para tareas empresariales
bajada: SpaceX AI lanzó Grok Bot, un servicio de agente IA siempre activo que funciona como 'compañeros de equipo' independientes. Los bots pueden iniciar sesión en apps y herramientas existentes para completar tareas multi-paso.
bajada_en: SpaceX AI launched Grok Bot, an always-on AI agent service that works as independent 'AI teammates'. The bots can sign into existing apps and tools to complete multi-step tasks.

title: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. Google CEO Sundar Pichai posted on X that a billion people are using Gemini every month, and that Gemini is Google's fastest-growing product ever. A billion users is a huge milestone, but Google isn't the first AI app to hit it. OpenAI's ChatGPT […]
title_es: ChatGPT y Gemini alcanzan cada uno 1 billón de usuarios
bajada: ChatGPT y Gemini han alcanzado hito de 1 billón de usuarios mensuales, consolidando dominio de ambas plataformas. Gemini es el producto de Google de crecimiento más rápido en su historia.
bajada_en: ChatGPT and Gemini have each reached 1 billion monthly users, consolidating dominance for both platforms. Gemini is Google's fastest-growing product ever.

title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
summary: OpenAI research reveals how enterprises are adopting agentic AI, using ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.
title_es: OpenAI: cómo las empresas están adoptando IA agéntica
bajada: OpenAI publica investigación sobre cómo las empresas usan ChatGPT y modelos agenticos en producción. El estudio revela que las firmas líderes están ampliando significativamente su adopción de IA más allá del uso conversacional.
bajada_en: OpenAI publishes research on how enterprises are using ChatGPT and agentic models in production. The study shows that leading firms are significantly expanding their AI adoption beyond conversational use.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard Deliver Faster, Smarter, More Efficient Agentic AI
summary: As AI shifts from chatbots to autonomous agents, open models are serving market demands for full control over where AI runs and how it’s deployed and evolves. Today, NVIDIA is expanding its Nemotron 3 model family with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, the highest-efficiency model in its class for long-running agentic AI workloads. This release follows Nemotron […]
title_es: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: modelo optimizado para IA agéntica
bajada: NVIDIA lanza Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, su modelo más eficiente para workloads agenticos de larga duración. La nueva versión acompaña a NeMo Switchyard para ofrecer mayor control sobre dónde y cómo se despliega la IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, its most efficient model for long-running agentic workloads. The new version comes with NeMo Switchyard to provide greater control over AI deployment.

title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
summary: OpenAI and AWS are making Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock to support enterprise security workflows.
title_es: OpenAI integra modelos Daybreak en AWS para ciberseguridad
bajada: OpenAI y AWS hacen disponibles las capacidades de ciberseguridad Daybreak a través de Amazon Bedrock. La integración permite que empresas accedan a herramientas de seguridad avanzadas en flujos de trabajo de seguridad empresarial.
bajada_en: OpenAI and AWS make Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock. The integration allows enterprises to access advanced security tools in their security workflows.

title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.
title_es: OpenAI comienza a probar publicidad en ChatGPT
bajada: OpenAI inicia pruebas de anuncios en ChatGPT para financiar acceso gratuito con etiquetado claro y protecciones de privacidad. Los usuarios tendrán control sobre los anuncios y la respuesta de la IA permanecerá independiente de los publicistas.
bajada_en: OpenAI starts testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access with clear labeling and privacy protections. Users will have control over ads and AI responses remain independent from advertisers.

title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith’s valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
summary: Blacksmith says revenue has grown more than tenfold over the past year.
title_es: Blacksmith: startup de testing de IA crece 10x en valuación
bajada: Blacksmith, empresa especializada en testing de código con IA, aumentó su valuación casi 10 veces en menos de un año. Su ingresos crecieron más de tenfold, reflejando la demanda creciente en validación de software impulsada por IA.
bajada_en: Blacksmith, specialized in AI code testing, increased its valuation nearly 10x in less than a year. Revenue has grown more than tenfold, reflecting growing demand in AI-driven software validation.

title: A New Trick Reveals AI Models’ Inner Thoughts
summary: Researchers devised a way to extract “reasoning traces” from Claude, GPT, and Gemini. What they found, they say, indicates that some Chinese AI may be trained on leading US models.
title_es: Nueva técnica revela el 'pensamiento' interno de modelos IA
bajada: Investigadores desarrollaron un método para extraer 'trazas de razonamiento' de Claude, GPT y Gemini. Sus hallazgos sugieren que algunos modelos IA chinos podrían entrenarse sobre modelos estadounidenses líderes.
bajada_en: Researchers devised a method to extract 'reasoning traces' from Claude, GPT, and Gemini. Their findings suggest some Chinese AI models may be trained on leading US models.

title: AMIE, our research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study.
title_es: AMIE de Google demuestra consultas médicas de video en tiempo real
bajada: AMIE, el sistema de IA médica de Google, demostró capacidades de consulta clínica por video en tiempo real en primer estudio de su tipo. El avance marca progreso significativo en IA para aplicaciones de salud clínica.
bajada_en: AMIE, Google's medical AI system, demonstrated real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study. The breakthrough marks significant progress in AI for clinical healthcare applications.

title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
summary: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.
title_es: OpenAI lanza aplicación de escritorio ChatGPT para Linux
bajada: OpenAI finalmente lleva su aplicación de escritorio de ChatGPT a sistemas operativos Linux. Esta es una expansión significativa de acceso para desarrolladores y usuarios de Linux que usaban versiones web.
bajada_en: OpenAI finally brings its dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems. This is a significant accessibility expansion for Linux developers and users previously relying on web versions.

title: Oh Lord, AI Reporters Are Actually Breaking Big News
summary: Last week, an AI newsroom beat mainstream journalists—including WIRED—to a story about OpenAI and hacking. It’s just the beginning.
title_es: Redacciones de IA rompen exclusivas antes que periodistas
bajada: Una redacción impulsada por IA recientemente adelantó a periodistas mainstream en una noticia sobre OpenAI y hacking. El incidente marca un punto de inflexión en cómo la IA está siendo usada en reportería de noticias.
bajada_en: An AI-powered newsroom recently beat mainstream journalists to a story about OpenAI and hacking. The incident marks a turning point in how AI is being used in news reporting.

title: NVIDIA and Local AI Community Fuel Open Source Models and Intelligent Agents
summary: The open source ecosystem is making it easier for AI enthusiasts and developers to build, customize and run increasingly capable agents locally.  Throughout August, NVIDIA is celebrating the partners and open source communities moving local AI forward, along with the models, applications and tools emerging across the ecosystem. That includes NVIDIA’s latest open models, software […]
title_es: NVIDIA impulsa modelos open source y agentes IA locales
bajada: NVIDIA celebra el ecosistema open source y comunidades que permiten a desarrolladores construir y ejecutar agentes IA cada vez más capaces localmente. Incluye nuevos modelos abiertos y herramientas de NVIDIA para facilitar desarrollo local.
bajada_en: NVIDIA celebrates the open source ecosystem and communities enabling developers to build and run increasingly capable AI agents locally. Includes NVIDIA's new open models and tools for easier local development.

title: Of course the ChatGPT dog cancer vaccine spawned a startup
summary: Remember that much-hyped story about an Australian tech entrepreneur using ChatGPT, Grok, and other AI tools to craft a personalized cancer vaccine for his dog? Well, surprise: he's launched a startup. That entrepreneur is Paul Conyngham, who says he is launching Gamgee to offer "personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs." But his ambitions go well […]
title_es: Vacuna para cáncer en perros genera startup emergente
bajada: Paul Conyngham lanzó Gamgee basándose en su proyecto viral de usar IA para crear vacuna personalizada contra cáncer para su perro. La startup planea ofrecer vacunas mRNA personalizadas para cáncer en perros y expandirse a otras aplicaciones.
bajada_en: Paul Conyngham launched Gamgee based on his viral project using AI to create a personalized cancer vaccine for his dog. The startup plans to offer personalized mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs and expand beyond.

title: Thinking of ACE? We Can Do It with Fewer Tokens
title_es: IBM: procesamiento eficiente de tokens en modelos grandes
bajada: IBM Research presenta método para optimizar el procesamiento de tokens en modelos IA, reduciendo la cantidad de tokens necesarios. La técnica mejora la eficiencia computacional sin sacrificar rendimiento de modelo.
bajada_en: IBM Research presents a method to optimize token processing in AI models, reducing required tokens. The technique improves computational efficiency without sacrificing model performance.
